system.description: The Dragon-Blood transforms raw recruits into soldiers worthy of the Realm's armies. Activating this Charm at the beginning of a two-week training regimen, the Exalt infuses her unit with elemental discipline matching her aspect. At the end of the two weeks, a rabble (Magnitude 0 or unformed group) becomes a proper military unit with Drill 3, Might 1, and Morale 3. An existing unit with lower ratings has each rating raised by 1 (to a maximum of 3/1/3). Dragon-Blooded soldiers (Dynasty) who train under this Charm raise their individual Drill to 4 and gain one point of Might. All affected soldiers' bodies are subtly marked by elemental Essence for the rest of their lives; Dragon-Blooded can detect them as products of this training with a successful (Perception + Occult) roll.
